items.question: What is the funding process at Altos Funding?
items.answer: Our funding process is simple: First, you sign up and choose your account size. Then, you complete a two-phase evaluation to demonstrate your trading skills. Once you pass, you get verified through our KYC process and receive your funded account within 24 hours. You can then start trading with our capital and keep up to 90% of your profits.

items.question: How fast are the payouts?
items.answer: We process payouts within 24 hours of your request. You can request a payout at any time once you have made profits. We support multiple payment methods including bank wire, crypto (Bitcoin, USDT), and other popular payment processors. There are no minimum payout amounts or hidden fees.

items.question: What trading platforms do you support?
items.answer: We fully support MetaTrader 4 (MT4) with all features including Expert Advisors (EAs), custom indicators, and advanced charting tools. We provide institutional-grade execution with minimal slippage and the lowest spreads in the industry. You can trade Forex, indices, commodities, and cryptocurrencies.

items.question: What are the main trading rules?
items.answer: Our rules are transparent and trader-friendly: You must achieve your profit target (8-10% depending on account size) while keeping your maximum daily loss under 5% and total drawdown under 5-6%. There are no hidden rules, no restrictions on trading style, and you can hold positions overnight and over weekends. News trading and EAs are allowed.

items.question: What leverage do you offer?
items.answer: We offer competitive leverage up to 1:100 on all account sizes. This allows you to maximize your trading opportunities while maintaining proper risk management. The leverage is consistent across all instruments and account types, giving you the flexibility to execute your trading strategy effectively.

items.question: Can I use Expert Advisors (EAs) and trading bots?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! We fully support the use of Expert Advisors, trading bots, and any automated trading strategies on our MT4 platform. As long as your trading complies with our basic risk management rules, you are free to use any trading method or tool you prefer.

items.question: What happens if I fail the evaluation?
items.answer: If you don't pass the evaluation on your first attempt, you can retake it. Depending on your account size, you may get free retakes (Professional and Elite accounts). For Starter accounts, retakes are available at a discounted rate. We also provide detailed performance analytics to help you improve for your next attempt.

items.question: Is there a time limit for the evaluation?
items.answer: Our Starter account has a 30-day time limit for the evaluation phase. However, our Professional and Elite accounts come with unlimited time to complete the evaluation, allowing you to trade at your own pace without pressure. Once you're funded, there are no time limits on your trading.

items.question: What is the profit split and are there any fees?
items.answer: Our profit split ranges from 80% to 90% depending on your account size - you keep the majority of your profits! The only fee is the one-time evaluation fee when you sign up. There are no monthly fees, no platform fees, no inactivity fees, and no payout fees. What you earn is what you keep.

items.question: How much capital can I get funded with?
items.answer: You can start with a $25K funded account and scale up to $200K. We also offer account scaling - consistently profitable traders can request increases to their funded capital, allowing you to grow your account size as you demonstrate success. Top traders can manage multiple accounts simultaneously.

articleTextInventory: Altos Funding lets you start your trading challenge in just a few steps, with no complicated setup. Follow the guide below — from sign-up to your first trade.
Go to the Altos Funding login page and click Sign Up. You can register quickly with your Google account, or sign up directly with your email and password.
Before purchasing a challenge, add funds to your account. Go to My Profile > My Asset and click the Deposit button on the Total Asset card.
In the Deposit window: 1) enter the amount (min 10 USDT), 2) select the network (e.g. TRC-20), 3) send USDT to the address shown, then 4) paste your Transaction ID (TxID) and click Deposit.
Only send USDT via the selected network. Using the wrong network may result in permanent loss. Deposits are credited after network confirmations.
Click Start New Challenge in the dashboard sidebar, then choose your account type: Starter ($100), Professional ($300), or Elite ($500). Pay with your USDT balance.
Once your purchase is complete, your MT4 login credentials are sent to your email, including login, password, server, and challenge start/end times.
Email — Your Challenge Account is Ready
You can also view account details anytime from the Challenge menu in your dashboard.
Check your Challenge Start time. Trading is only available after the start time, and you must reach your target before the end time.
Download MetaTrader 4 from Download Platform in the sidebar. Launch MT4, select the Altos server, and enter your login and password to connect.
Before placing an order, review your challenge rules (profit target and max drawdown). Select a symbol from Market Watch, then use New Order or one-click trading to Buy or Sell.
Holding a position overnight may incur a rollover (swap) fee. Positions held over Wednesday are charged a triple (3-day) swap.
What happens if I fail the challenge?
If you breach a challenge rule, that account is closed. You can purchase a new challenge and try again anytime.
Deposits are credited after the network confirms your transaction. Make sure you used the correct network and TxID.
Find your account number and password again in the Account Detail view under the Challenge menu.
Do I pass immediately when I hit the profit target?
Once you reach the profit target, your account is automatically reviewed after the challenge end time. Based on the result, you advance to the next stage or your funded account.

KYC (Know Your Customer) is an identity verification step required before using key features such as funded account withdrawals. It confirms your identity to keep your account and funds secure.

Your submitted documents are reviewed and processed automatically by a dedicated verification solution. There is no separate manual admin review, and in most cases the result is available shortly after submission.
Approved — Your identity has been successfully verified.
Rejected — There was an issue with your documents. You can review the reason and resubmit.
Unverified — Your documents have been submitted and are being reviewed.
If your verification is rejected, you can view the reason in the KYC menu of your dashboard. The most common reasons are:
The document image is blurry or hard to read due to glare
Please retake a clear photo of the full document in a well-lit environment and resubmit.
